title: Lion and Antelope
simplified_paragraphs: 每天，当太阳升起来的时候，非洲大草原上的动物们就开始奔跑了。狮子妈妈在教育自己的孩子：“孩子，你必须跑得再快一点，再快一点，你要是跑不过最慢的羚羊，你就会被饿死。”在另外一个地方，羚羊妈妈也在教育自己的孩子：“孩子，你必须跑得再快一点，再快一点，如果你不能比跑得最快的狮子还快，那你就肯定会被他们吃掉，成为他们的食物。”
请记住：你跑得快，别人跑得更快，所以我们要不断地提高自己。
traditional_paragraphs: 每天，當太陽升起來的時候，非洲大草原上的動物們就開始奔跑了。獅子媽媽在教育自己的孩子：“孩子，你必須跑得再快一點，再快一點，你要是跑不過最慢的羚羊，你就會被餓死。”在另外一個地方，羚羊媽媽也在教育自己的孩子：“孩子，你必須跑得再快一點，再快一點，如果你不能比跑得最快的獅子還快，那你就肯定會被他們吃掉，成為他們的食物。”
請記住：你跑得快，別人跑得更快，所以我們要不斷地提高自己。
pinyin_paragraphs: měi tiān， dāng tài yáng shēng qǐ lái de shí hou， Fēi zhōu dà cǎo yuán shàng de dòng wù men jiù kāi shǐ bēn pǎo le。 shī zi mā ma zài jiào yù zì jǐ de hái zi：“ hái zi， nǐ bì xū pǎo de zài kuài yī diǎn， zài kuài yī diǎn， nǐ yào shì pǎo bù guò zuì màn de líng yáng， nǐ jiù huì bèi è sǐ。” zài lìng wài yī gè dì fang， líng yáng mā ma yě zài jiào yù zì jǐ de hái zi：“ hái zi， nǐ bì xū pǎo de zài kuài yī diǎn， zài kuài yī diǎn， rú guǒ nǐ bù néng bǐ pǎo de zuì kuài de shī zi hái kuài， nà nǐ jiù kěn dìng huì bèi tā men chī diào， chéng wéi tā men de shí wù。”
qǐng jì zhu： nǐ pǎo de kuài， bié rén pǎo de gèng kuài， suǒ yǐ wǒ men yào bù duàn de tí gāo zì jǐ。
english_paragraphs: Every day, when the sun rises, the animals on the African savanna start running. A mother lion tells her cub, “You must run faster and faster. If you can’t outrun the slowest antelope, you’ll starve.” Elsewhere, a mother antelope tells her young one, “You must run faster and faster. If you can’t outrun the fastest lion, they’ll catch you and eat you.”
Remember: however fast you run, someone else runs faster. That’s why we must keep improving ourselves.
english_full:
Every day, when the sun rises, the animals on the African savanna start running. A mother lion tells her cub, “You must run faster and faster. If you can’t outrun the slowest antelope, you’ll starve.” Elsewhere, a mother antelope tells her young one, “You must run faster and faster. If you can’t outrun the fastest lion, they’ll catch you and eat you.”

Remember: however fast you run, someone else runs faster. That’s why we must keep improving ourselves.
